prompt: Write the body (about 180 words) of a demand letter from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer before a lawsuit. Accident: sideswipe while changing lanes. Injury: back strain. Use the exact placeholders [CLIENT_NAME], [LOSS_DATE] and [DEMAND_AMOUNT]. No other names or dates. (Internal reference C-1376; do not mention it.)
text:
Our client, [CLIENT_NAME], was lawfully traveling in the right lane when your insured changed lanes without signaling or checking the blind spot. The vehicles made contact, pushing our client's car sideways and forcing it against the guardrail. The collision was entirely caused by your insured's failure to yield and keep a proper lookout, and the police report and photographs taken at the scene confirm the point of impact on our client's driver-side rear quarter panel.

As a result of the collision on [LOSS_DATE], our client suffered a significant back strain. Immediately after the impact, our client experienced sharp lower back pain radiating into the left leg, stiffness, and reduced range of motion. Treatment has included emergency evaluation, imaging, prescribed medication, and a course of physical therapy. Our client has missed substantial time from work and continues to experience limitations in daily activities.

Liability in this matter is clear. Under the applicable traffic laws, a driver changing lanes must ensure the move can be made safely, and your insured did not. We therefore request that your company tender payment of [DEMAND_AMOUNT] to resolve all claims arising from this collision. This offer will remain open for thirty days from the date of this letter. If we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we will file suit without further notice.
